description: Find Slack threads where Michael promised something or was asked for something, and keep a ledger of what's decided.

scan.description: scan [--days 30 | --since-last] | import TRIAGE.json | record KEY STATUS [--ticket ID] [--note TEXT] [--title TEXT] [--asker NAME] | ledger [--status open] | tickets

morning.description: Start the morning sweep session in swarm (scan, triage, reconcile /today ticks, top picks, note), wait for it, and fail unless today's scan and note landed.
